items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: You know what’s the Stravinsky quote, that composition is selective improvisation.

ctx.x: I’m not sure if there was a specific answer to how it’s done that I’d even want to know because it takes some of the — it’s magic I guess, is what I’m trying to say.

It’s some kind of magic in one sense, and then in another it’s like — I guess it’s like poetry or, you know, having mastered enough of the theoretical knowledge — for me — of you know theory and harmony and playing music, classical music you know, and I’m very influenced by Debussy and Ravel, their beautiful compositions which are very improvised also. You know what’s the Stravinsky quote, that composition is selective improvisation. And that, you know, that’s just the way it is. You sit down, you know as it…

Theoretical knowledge you mentioned — I’m curious because we go back a long ways and you come from a small town called Verona, New York, and I remember wondering back then seeing you in this band called Dry Jack, where did you and your brother, how did you come to this music, which at the time we would have — we’ll call it jazz fusion I guess.
